english.title: Hold onto trailer for purpose of being drawn
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of being drawn,

(A)_[took]_
(B)_[retained]_

hold of a trailer in motion on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).
english.legislation: Contrary to section 26(2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
took/retained hold of trailer on a road
for the purpose of being drawn

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See offence wording H3012 if offence committed by pedal cyclist.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wording: H3014.
(iv) In the Statement of Facts give details of the speed of the vehicle and whether the defendant was wearing roller skates, roller blades or a skateboard etc.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant held onto **(..SPECIFY TRAILER..) while it was moving on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
